correctness.rationale: The first-event Markov recurrence is exact and terminates. The standalone symbolic checker covers every unweighted undirected n<=4 graph up to explicit permutation isomorphism, and all 33 rooted positive-rate derivative numerators and denominators have nonnegative polynomial coefficients (strict positive derivative for nontrivial components). For the B3 witness at beta=100, independent exact Fraction arithmetic establishes the displayed positive 1326298572426638149591240301/28318637979426772160758383665220 difference from H5=137/60. A spanning-tree fast-infection coupling plus uniform-integrability domination establishes the high-rate expected-time limit. An independent 146-state numerical generator evaluation verifies the witness to numerical tolerance; finite calculations are not substitutes for the exact sign and asymptotic proofs.

originality.rationale: Searched publicly indexed scientific claims using multiple aliases and compared closest claim implications. The nearest inspected prior article on duration, Holme (2013), proves nonmonotonic phenomena in a different fixed-period discrete-time mechanism; López-García (2015) gives exact CTMC duration computation but no sharp 4/5-vertex qualitative classification in the inspected full manuscript. Sharkey et al. (2012) cover exact SIR on trees, not the cyclic witness. Novelty is strictly the exact sharp graph-size threshold and five-vertex exponential-recovery counterexample, not the general idea that epidemic durations may be nonmonotone. Residual risk from older exact small-graph enumerations is acknowledged.
residual_risks: Unidentified earlier exact small-SIR-network duration tables might contain equivalent derivative classifications or the same witness.
A generic finite-state Markov formula makes the example computable in principle; novelty rests on exact graph-size threshold and sign certification, not technique.
Citation access and literature indexing cannot establish a proof of historical uniqueness.

value.rationale: The smallest graph size at which a natural epidemic observable violates rate-monotonicity is a mathematically motivated invariant. The full n<=4 obstruction coupled with an exact n=5 seven-edge counterexample is a substantive finite classification, useful as a sharp benchmarking case for network epidemic duration sensitivity. The result does not assert public-health effect sizes or a full five-vertex census.
